title: Cost Pressures in the Pipeline Could Keep Inflation High
title_zh: 供應鏈成本壓力可能讓通膨居高不下
subtitle: 供應鏈成本壓力可能讓通膨居高不下
author: Dow Jones Newswires

sentences.en: “What we hear from companies very clearly is that there are huge cost pressures in their supply chains,” Wilson said in an interview with The Wall Street Journal.
sentences.zh: Wilson 接受《華爾街日報》訪問時說：「我們從企業那裡聽得非常清楚，他們的供應鏈有巨大的成本壓力。」

sentences.en: “The inflationary impact could be more persistent.”

On the basis of contacts with businesses around the world, Wilson estimated that costs for manufacturers of consumer goods could be as much as 10% to 12% higher than they were before the war began in late February.
sentences.zh: 根據與全球企業的接觸，Wilson 估計消費品製造商的成本，可能比二月底戰爭開始前高出多達 10% 到 12%。

sentences.en: The music industry is on track to hit 1 billion paying subscribers by 2028, Universal Music Group’s CFO Matt Ellis says at the Morgan Stanley European Technology, Media & Telecom Conference in Barcelona.
sentences.zh: 環球音樂集團財務長 Matt Ellis 在巴塞隆納的摩根士丹利歐洲科技、媒體與電信會議上表示，音樂產業可望在 2028 年前達到 10 億付費訂閱用戶。

sentences.en: The record label said at its capital markets day in 2024 that it expected revenue to benefit substantially from a growing base of subscribers who would be willing to pay to listen to music.
sentences.zh: 這家唱片公司在 2024 年的資本市場日上表示，預期營收將因願意付費聽音樂的訂閱用戶不斷增加而大幅受惠。

sentences.en: Citing its own survey, JPM expects further growth in use of GLP-1 drugs like Novo Nordisk’s Ozempic or Eli Lilly’s Mounjaro.
sentences.zh: 摩根大通引用自家的調查，預期諾和諾德的 Ozempic 或禮來的 Mounjaro 這類 GLP-1 藥物的使用會進一步成長。

sentences.en: Sales of beer, spirits and wine could suffer from greater penetration of the drugs, which can reduce users’ desire to drink and affects the taste of beverages.
sentences.zh: 隨著這類藥物更加普及，啤酒、烈酒和葡萄酒的銷售可能受到衝擊，因為這些藥物會降低使用者想喝酒的慾望，也會影響飲料的味道。

vocab.usage: supply chain disruption 供應鏈中斷；cause disruption 造成干擾；動詞 disrupt
vocab.example: The strike caused major disruptions to travel.
vocab.example_zh: 罷工對交通造成重大干擾。

vocab.usage: global supply chain 全球供應鏈；TOEIC 物流／製造題常見
vocab.example: Our supply chain depends on Asian factories.
vocab.example_zh: 我們的供應鏈仰賴亞洲工廠。

vocab.usage: armed conflict 武裝衝突；a conflict of interest 利益衝突（TOEIC 常考）
vocab.example: Please avoid any conflict of interest.

vocab.usage: a lasting agreement / impression 持久的協議／深刻印象
vocab.example: The trip left a lasting impression on me.
vocab.example_zh: 這趟旅行讓我印象深刻。

vocab.usage: represent a company / client；名詞 representative 代表（sales representative 業務代表）
vocab.example: She represents our company at trade shows.
vocab.example_zh: 她在商展代表我們公司。

vocab.usage: sustained growth / rise 持續成長／上升；動詞 sustain
vocab.example: The company has seen sustained growth.

vocab.usage: cost / price pressures 成本／價格壓力；under pressure to do… 被迫要…
vocab.example: We are under pressure to cut costs.
vocab.example_zh: 我們有降低成本的壓力。

vocab.usage: persistent inflation 頑固通膨；persistent problem 一直存在的問題
vocab.example: There is a persistent problem with the printer.
vocab.example_zh: 印表機一直有個老問題。

vocab.usage: estimate that…；名詞 estimate（發音不同）；a rough estimate 粗估
vocab.example: We estimate the project will take six weeks.
vocab.example_zh: 我們估計這個案子要六週。

vocab.usage: car / drug manufacturer 汽車／藥品製造商；動詞 manufacture
vocab.example_zh: 製造商召回了一萬輛車。

vocab.usage: be on track to do… 有望做到…；get back on track 回到正軌
vocab.example: We are on track to finish by Friday.
vocab.example_zh: 我們有望在週五前完成。

vocab.usage: paying subscribers 付費用戶；動詞 subscribe to…；名詞 subscription
vocab.example_zh: 這個 App 有 200 萬名訂閱用戶。

vocab.usage: ＝significantly；形容詞 substantial（a substantial increase 大幅增加）
annual revenue 年營收；generate revenue 創造營收；revenue ≠ profit（利潤）
cite a survey / reason 引用調查／提出理由；citing… 引述…
vocab.example: The manager cited rising costs as the reason.
vocab.example_zh: 經理以成本上升作為理由。

vocab.usage: conduct a survey 進行調查；customer survey 顧客問卷（TOEIC 常見）
vocab.example_zh: 請填寫我們的顧客問卷。

vocab.usage: market penetration 市場滲透率；smartphone penetration 智慧型手機普及率
vocab.example: Market penetration is still low in rural areas.
vocab.example_zh: 鄉村地區的市場滲透率仍然很低。

vocab.usage: 比 drink 正式；food and beverage (F&B) 餐飲業
vocab.example: Hot beverages are served in the lobby.

vocab.usage: 形容詞 cautious；be cautiously optimistic 審慎樂觀（常見）
